main-desktop-preferences.description: The bundled main workspace can read and update only the reviewed desktop preferences exposed by Jarvis commands.

quick-local-conversation.description: The local quick window can call only reviewed desktop commands; business traffic goes through the authenticated FastAPI connection.

splash-runtime-control.description: The local launch window can observe and control the Jarvis-owned source runtime during V4-0.

status-runtime-diagnostics.description: The local status center can inspect Jarvis runtime evidence and invoke only reviewed recovery actions.
